message.content:
When owners are looking for a **conversion-friendly** collection or soft-brand option in **North America**, the brands most commonly considered are **Hilton’s Curio Collection and Tapestry Collection**, **Marriott’s Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, and Delta Hotels**, **IHG’s Vignette Collection and voco**, and **Accor’s Handwritten Collection**.[11][15][8]

If the property is being positioned more as a **true conversion-first flag** rather than a soft brand, commonly cited options also include **Hilton’s Spark**, **IHG’s Garner**, **Marriott’s Moxy/City Express by Marriott**, and **Choice’s conversion-focused flags** such as **MainStay Suites, Suburban Studios, Clarion Pointe, and Quality Inn**.[3][4][5][8][12][14]

For a quick practical framing:
- **Soft/collection brands** are usually chosen when an owner wants to keep more of the property’s independent character while gaining a major distribution and loyalty system.[11][15]
- **Conversion-first brands** are usually chosen when the priority is faster reflagging, lower capital spend, and a format that fits an existing building more easily.[4][5][8][12]
